mapper.select: SELECT a.asset_id, a.port_name, a.port_index, a.port_type, t.point_x, t.point_y, t.port_mode, t.node_id, t.parent_id, a.status, t.update_date, t.rotation from (SELECT * FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES b WHERE b.COLLECT_CODE = (SELECT MAX(to_number(c.COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES c where c.asset_id = #{assetId}) order by b.PORT_INDEX_RANK) a LEFT JOIN topo_asset_port t ON a.port_index = t.port_index and a.asset_id = t.asset_id where (a.port_type = 6 or a.port_type = 18 or a.port_type = 22 or a.port_type = 23 or a.port_type = 39 or a.port_type = 135 or a.port_type = 56) and a.PORT_INDEX not like '%VLAN%' and a.PORT_INDEX not like '%Vlan%' and a.port_index not like concat(concat('%', '.'), '%')

SELECT a.asset_id, a.port_name, a.port_index, t.point_x, t.point_y, t.node_id, t.parent_id, a.status, t.update_date from (SELECT * FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES b WHERE b.COLLECT_CODE = (SELECT MAX(to_number(c.COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES c where c.asset_id = #{assetId}) order by b.PORT_INDEX_RANK) a LEFT JOIN topo_asset_port t ON a.port_index = t.port_index and a.asset_id = t.asset_id where a.port_index like concat(concat('%', #{portIndex}), '%')

SELECT a.asset_id, a.port_name, a.port_index, t.point_x, t.point_y, t.node_id, t.parent_id, a.status, t.update_date from (SELECT * FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES b WHERE b.COLLECT_CODE = (SELECT MAX(to_number(c.COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES c where c.asset_id = #{assetId}) order by b.PORT_INDEX_RANK) a LEFT JOIN topo_asset_port t ON a.port_index = t.port_index and a.asset_id = t.asset_id where a.port_index like concat(concat('%E%', #{portIndex}), '%')

select a.asset_id, a.port_name, a.port_index, t.is_port from (SELECT * FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES b WHERE b.COLLECT_CODE = (SELECT MAX(to_number(c.COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES c where c.asset_id = #{assetId}) order by b.PORT_INDEX_RANK) a LEFT JOIN TOPO_VERTEX t on a.asset_id = t.asset_id and a.port_index = t.port_index and t.is_port = 1 where a.port_type in(6,18,22,23,39,56)

select a.asset_id, a.port_name, a.port_index, t.is_port from (SELECT * FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES b WHERE b.COLLECT_CODE = (SELECT MAX(to_number(c.COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES c where c.asset_id = #{assetId}) order by b.PORT_INDEX_RANK) a LEFT JOIN TOPO_VERTEX t on a.asset_id = t.asset_id and a.port_index = t.port_index and t.is_port = 1 where (a.port_type = 6 or a.port_type = 18 or a.port_type = 22 or a.port_type = 23 or a.port_type = 39 or a.port_type = 56) and a.port_link_type =1 and a.port_index not like concat(concat('%', '.'), '%')

SELECT asset_id, vlan_name as port_name, vlan_index as port_index FROM COLLECT_VLAN b WHERE b.COLLECT_CODE = (SELECT MAX(to_number(c.COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_VLAN c where c.asset_id = #{assetId}) order by b.vlan_index

SELECT asset_id,port_name,port_index,port_type,status FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES WHERE COLLECT_CODE = (SELECT MAX(to_number(COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES where asset_id = #{assetId}) and ASSET_ID =#{assetId} and (port_type = 6 or port_type = 18 or port_type = 22 or port_type = 23 or port_type = 39 or port_type = 56) and port_index not like concat(concat('%', '.'), '%') order by PORT_INDEX_RANK

SELECT asset_id,port_name,port_index,port_type,status FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES WHERE COLLECT_CODE = (SELECT MAX(to_number(COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_INTERFACES where asset_id = #{assetId}) and ASSET_ID =#{assetId} and (port_type = 6 or port_type = 18 or port_type = 22 or port_type = 23 or port_type = 39 or port_type = 56) and port_index not like concat(concat('%', '.'), '%') and port_link_type =1 order by PORT_INDEX_RANK
